description: This file defines an abstract class 'NoteViewHolder' used in an Android application for displaying note items within a RecyclerView. It includes methods for binding note status, category, favorite status, and searchable content, as well as handling item details for selection and swipe actions.

classes.name: NoteViewHolder
classes.description: An abstract ViewHolder class for displaying note items in a RecyclerView, providing binding methods for status, category, favorite indicator, and searchable content, as well as item details for selection and swipe actions.

methods.name: NoteViewHolder
methods.description: Constructor initializing the ViewHolder with a view and a note click listener, and setting recyclability to false.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds the selection state and note data to the view, setting click behavior.

methods.name: bindStatus
methods.description: Sets the visibility and tint of the note's status indicator based on the note's DBStatus.

methods.name: bindCategory
methods.description: Displays the note's category with appropriate styling, depending on whether it is shown and the current theme.

methods.name: bindFavorite
methods.description: Sets the favorite icon resource and click listener for the note.

methods.name: bindSearchableContent
methods.description: Displays the note's content and highlights search query matches if provided.

methods.name: showSwipe
methods.description: Abstract method to show swipe actions, to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: getNoteSwipeable
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the swipeable view component.

methods.name: getItemDetails
methods.description: Provides item details for selection and interaction within RecyclerView.
